definition: server_ms is the Server-Timing presign;dur value of each 200 response: the time from the start of the route handler to the response, rate limit and lookup included, network and platform routing not included. wall_ms is the round trip measured by the probe, network included. cold_start_server_ms and cold_start_wall_ms are from the first 200 of the run (cold check cache and instance warmup on the probe's seller URL). p50 and p99 are nearest-rank over the remaining 200 responses (after the first). The probe sends the calls one after another with the same 402, so later calls can hit the 60-second check cache. This file counts the calls of this probe run only, not other callers.
